title: Priests and Prophets

questions.question: What is the inheritance of the Levitical priests?
options: The Lord is their inheritance; they eat the offerings
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord is their inheritance; they eat the offerings
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:1–2 (ESV): "The Levitical priests... shall have no portion... They shall eat the food offerings to the Lord... The Lord is their inheritance..."

questions.question: What part of the ox or sheep sacrifices belongs to the priest?
options: The shoulder, the two cheeks, and the stomach
questions.correctAnswer: The shoulder, the two cheeks, and the stomach
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:3 (ESV): "...they shall give to the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the stomach."

questions.question: What practices are abominable to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:10–11 (ESV): "There shall not be found among you... anyone who practices divination or tells fortunes... or a necromancer..."

questions.question: Who will the Lord raise up for the people?
options: A prophet like Moses from among their brothers
questions.correctAnswer: A prophet like Moses from among their brothers
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:15 (ESV): "The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your brothers..."

questions.question: How do you know a word the Lord has not spoken?
options: If the word does not come to pass or come true
questions.correctAnswer: If the word does not come to pass or come true
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:22 (ESV): "...if the word does not come to pass or come true, that is a word that the Lord has not spoken..."

questions.question: What should be given to the priest as firstfruits?
options: Grain, wine, oil, and the first of the fleece of sheep
questions.correctAnswer: Grain, wine, oil, and the first of the fleece of sheep
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:4 (ESV): "The firstfruits of your grain... and the first of the fleece of your sheep..."

questions.question: Why did God choose Levi?
options: To stand and minister in the name of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: To stand and minister in the name of the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:5 (ESV): "For the Lord your God has chosen him... to stand and minister in the name of the Lord..."

questions.question: If a Levite comes from a clear town to the place God chooses, can he minister?
options: Yes, like all his fellow Levites
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, like all his fellow Levites
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:6–7 (ESV): "...then he may minister in the name of the Lord his God, like all his fellow Levites..."

questions.question: What happens to the prophet who speaks presumptuously in God’s name?
options: Whatever he says, he shall die
questions.correctAnswer: Whatever he says, he shall die
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:20 (ESV): "But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in my name... that same prophet shall die."

questions.question: Israel must be what before the Lord?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:13 (ESV): "You shall be blameless before the Lord your God."

questions.question: Why did the people ask not to hear God’s voice at Horeb?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:16 (ESV): "Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord... lest I die."

questions.question: What will God do to whoever does not listen to the Prophet?
options: He will require it of him
questions.correctAnswer: He will require it of him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:19 (ESV): "...whoever will not listen to my words... I myself will require it of him."

questions.question: Those who burn their sons/daughters are described as performing what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:12 (ESV): "for whoever does these things is an abomination to the Lord..."

questions.question: A country Levite who comes to serve shall eat equal portions, besides what?
options: What he receives from the sale of his patrimony
questions.correctAnswer: What he receives from the sale of his patrimony
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:8 (ESV): "They shall have equal portions to eat, besides what he receives from the sale of his patrimony."

questions.question: God will put His words in the Prophet's mouth, and he shall speak what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 18:18 (ESV): "...And I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him."

key_verse_text: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your brothers—it is to him you shall listen. (ESV)
